tasks.title: Implement Abandoned Cart Recovery Emails
tasks.description: Automatically send emails to customers who abandon their carts. Can recover 10-15% of lost sales.
tasks.instructions:
## HIGH PRIORITY: Implement Abandoned Cart Recovery Emails

### 🎯 Objective
Automatically send emails to customers who abandon their carts. Can recover 10-15% of lost sales.

**Category:** Marketing Automation
**Estimated Time:** 5 hours
**Business Impact:** high
**Technical Complexity:** medium

### 📋 Implementation Steps

1. **Planning & Setup**
   - Review existing similar features in the codebase
   - Install/configure: Email service (Resend), Background job queue
   - Design data models if needed

2. **Core Implementation**
      - Create/modify files: /app/api/cron/abandoned-cart/route.ts, /lib/email/abandoned-cart.ts
   - Implement core functionality
   - Add proper TypeScript types
   - Include error handling and validation

3. **Integration**
   - Integrate with existing features
   - Add to navigation if user-facing
   - Update any affected components

4. **Testing & Polish**
   - Test all functionality thoroughly
   - Verify responsive design
   - Check error states and edge cases
   - Optimize performance

### ✅ Definition of Done
- Feature works as specified
- No console errors
- Responsive on all screen sizes
- Proper error handling
- Code follows project conventions
- TypeScript types complete

visual: Responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
Error messages are clear and helpful
performance: Page/API loads within acceptable time (<3s for pages, <500ms for APIs)
